newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine senate to vote on tax evasion law.
newsitem.headline: Argentine senate to vote on tax evasion law.

text.p: Argentina's senate is due to debate a law on tough new measures to punish tax evaders Thursday.
The proposal is part of the government's push to improve its level of tax collection and would make it possible to imprison serious tax evaders for up to nine years.
The law has already got the go ahead in the chamber of deputies.
On Wednesday the Senate passed a law enabling authorities to shut down shops that failed to present receipts.

Separately, the government failed to obtain quorum in the chamber of deputies Wednesday for its plans to privatize the country's 59 airports. However, the government hopes to get the law passed before the end of the year.
